text: Wazni beriyan aur qaid-o-band ko yaad rakho: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai zaban se logon ki aib-geeri karne wala apne kamon se dusron ki haqarat karne wala, kharabi wala shakhs hai. Hummaz mashsha'in-bi-nameem ki tafsir bayan ho chuki hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke is se murad ta'ana dene wala, ghibat karne wala hai. Rabee bin Anas kehte hain samne bura kehna to humz hai aur peeth peeche aib bayan karna lumz hai. Qatada kehte hain zaban se aur aankh ke isharon se bandagan-e-Allah ko satana aur chirana murad hai ke kabhi to un ka gosht khaye yani ghibat kare aur kabhi un par ta'ana-zani kare. Mujahid farmate hain humz hath aur aankh se hota hai aur lumz zaban se. Baaz kehte hain is se murad Akhnas bin Shuraik kafir hai. Mujahid farmate hain aayat aam hai. Phir farmaya jo jama karta hai aur gin gin kar rakhta jata hai jaise aur jagah hai jama'a fa-au'a. Hazrat Ka'ab farmate hain din bhar to maal kamane ki haye-waye mein laga raha aur raat ko sari bhasi laash ki tarah para raha. Is ka khayal yeh hai ke is ka maal ise hamesha duniya mein rakhe ga, halanke waqiya yun nahin balkay yeh bakheel aur lalchi insaan jahannam ke us tabqay mein gire ga jo har us cheez ko jo is mein gire chur-chur kar deta hai. Phir farmata hai yeh tor-phor karne wali kya cheez hai? Is ka haal aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhein maloom nahin, yeh Allah ki sulgayi hui aag hai jo dilon par charh jati hai, jala kar bhasm kar deti hai lekin marte nahin. Hazrat Sabit Bunani jab is aayat ki tilawat kar ke is ka yeh ma'ani bayan karte to ro dete aur kehte inhe azab ne bada sataya. Muhammad bin Ka'ab farmate hain aag jalati hui halaq tak pahunch jati hai phir laut-ti phir pahunchti hai. Yeh aag un par charon taraf se band kar di gayi hai jaise ke Surah Al-Balad ki tafsir mein guzra. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai aur dusra tareeq is ka mauqoof hai, loha jo misl aag ke hai us ke sutonon mein yeh lambe lambe darwaze hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ki qira'at mein bi-amad marvi hai. In dozakhiyon ki gardanon mein zanjeerein hongi, yeh lambe lambe sutonon mein jakre hue honge aur upar se darwaze band kar diye jayenge. In aag ke sutonon mein inhe badtareen azab diye jayenge. Abu Saleh farmate hain yani wazni beriyan aur qaid-o-band un ke liye hongi. Is surat ki tafsir bhi Allah ke fazl-o-karam se puri hui, falhamdulillah.

Hazrat Ka'ab farmate hain din bhar to maal kamane ki haye-waye mein laga raha aur raat ko sari bhasi laash ki tarah para raha. Is ka khayal yeh hai ke is ka maal ise hamesha duniya mein rakhe ga, halanke waqiya yun nahin balkay yeh bakheel aur lalchi insaan jahannam ke us tabqay mein gire ga jo har us cheez ko jo is mein gire chur-chur kar deta hai. Phir farmata hai yeh tor-phor karne wali kya cheez hai? Is ka haal aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhein maloom nahin, yeh Allah ki sulgayi hui aag hai jo dilon par charh jati hai, jala kar bhasm kar deti hai lekin marte nahin. Hazrat Sabit Bunani jab is aayat ki tilawat kar ke is ka yeh ma'ani bayan karte to ro dete aur kehte inhe azab ne bada sataya. Muhammad bin Ka'ab farmate hain aag jalati hui halaq tak pahunch jati hai phir laut-ti phir pahunchti hai. Yeh aag un par charon taraf se band kar di gayi hai jaise ke Surah Al-Balad ki tafsir mein guzra. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai aur dusra tareeq is ka mauqoof hai, loha jo misl aag ke hai us ke sutonon mein yeh lambe lambe darwaze hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ki qira'at mein bi-amad marvi hai. In dozakhiyon ki gardanon mein zanjeerein hongi, yeh lambe lambe sutonon mein jakre hue honge aur upar se darwaze band kar diye jayenge. In aag ke sutonon mein inhe badtareen azab diye jayenge. Abu Saleh farmate hain yani wazni beriyan aur qaid-o-band un ke liye hongi. Is surat ki tafsir bhi Allah ke fazl-o-karam se puri hui, falhamdulillah.
